terra.problem: Verse 31 is not explicitly identified as the LORD speaking; the quoted divine speech in verse 30 has ended. Verse 36 does describe the LORD’s heart lamenting for Moab.
“He restores what He has brought low” sounds like a general promise that God restores everyone or everything He judges. Verse 47 specifically promises Moab’s restoration in the latter days.
